purpose: Explicit missing-data registry. Missing means the field has been identified for research but no validated observation has yet been loaded in the relevant evidence layer; it does not mean zero.

statuses.researched_missing: Source/indicator identified, but a validated value is not yet stored in the atlas for the relevant coverage unit.
statuses.not_researched: The field has not yet been investigated for this record.
statuses.observed: A validated observation is stored with provenance.
statuses.partially_observed: Validated observations exist for some countries or periods while the wider target remains incomplete.

country_indicators.name: GDP (current US$)
country_indicators.reason: Canonical indicator identified; a validated repository-wide observation cache is not yet stored.

country_indicators.name: Population, total
country_indicators.reason: Denmark has a current population observation sourced from Statistics Denmark; a harmonized World Bank observation cache for all countries is not yet stored.

country_indicators.name: GDP per capita (current US$)
country_indicators.reason: Canonical indicator identified; country observations are not yet cached in the repository-wide evidence layer.

country_indicators.name: Inflation, consumer prices (annual %)
country_indicators.reason: Canonical source identified; Denmark has a monthly Statistics Denmark observation, but a harmonized annual cross-country cache is not yet stored.

country_indicators.name: Central government debt, total (% of GDP)
country_indicators.reason: Canonical source identified; country observations are not yet cached in the repository.

countries.note: Denmark is the first country promoted from scaffold/overlay status to sourced-core enrichment. This does not imply completeness of the Danish record.

country_enrichment_status.coverage_rule: A country is empirically enriched only when validated observations with provenance have been loaded. Overlay-file existence alone never changes the count.

next_research_batches.definition_of_done: Country observations stored with country_id, reference_period, source, publication/retrieval dates and status; no missing value is silently converted to zero.
Debt observations stored with methodology notes where definitions differ; coverage gaps remain explicit.
Source and unit are explicit and cross-country comparability is documented.
Partner relationships can resolve to canonical country IDs and concentration metrics state their denominator and period.

research_rule: When an identified indicator is loaded for some countries but not others, record the observed countries and retain researched_missing for the uncovered countries. Never manufacture completeness from partial coverage.
